title: Marco Sanfratello
subtitle: Senior Software Engineer / Fullstack Software Engineer

__html: Senior Software Engineer with a strong focus on Java, Spring and React, combining solid technical expertise with a strong interest in complex software systems and problem solving.

Over the past years, I have developed significantly both as an engineer and as a person, taking on increasing responsibility for architecture, technical decisions and the delivery of demanding projects.

One of my strengths is working independently on complex problems. I care not only about delivering functional software, but also about making systems maintainable, testable and understandable over the long term.
My experience ranges from gradually modernising historically grown legacy applications to designing and implementing greenfield solutions from scratch.

I am increasingly interested in software architecture and technical leadership. In a greenfield project, I was responsible for the overall architecture and took on a combined architect and project lead role.
I value teamwork and technical exchange. I actively contribute to developer events and share knowledge on topics such as architecture, testability and development tools.
I also follow developments in AI-assisted software development with strong interest and use AI deliberately as a supporting tool in my daily work.
